card.name: Inside furosemide and pioglitazone names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of a few specific drug names, mainly the 'og' in pioglitazone and 'ro'/'uro' in furosemide or Furoscix. Also seen once inside a surname (Putterbaugh).

modes.label: Pioglitazone 'og'
modes.description: The 'og' piece after 'Pi' or 'pi' in pioglitazone.
modes.example: 7.7 Pi<<og>>litazone A decrease in the exposure

modes.label: Furosemide 'ro'/'uro'
modes.description: The middle piece of furosemide or Furoscix after the start of the name.
modes.example: Load the prefilled cartridge of f<<uro>>semide into the On-body Infus

card.writes: It seems to push toward finishing the rest of the name, though the listed tokens are not informative.
card.plain: It lights up partway through the names pioglitazone and furosemide, before the name is complete.
